name: super-admin
description: Has unrestricted access to the entire platform for system-wide configuration, management, and oversight of all users, projects, and operations.

name: admin
description: Platform administrators with elevated access to manage users, projects, hackathons, and platform settings.

name: business
description: Organizations, companies, or EdTech providers who create projects, host hackathons, and manage talent engagement on the platform.

name: talent
description: Individual talents who participate in hackathons, work on projects, and build skills through competitions and challenges.

name: user
description: General platform users who can participate in projects, view content, and engage with the Pacepard community.

name: mentor
description: Mentors who provide guidance and support in projects, hackathons, and workspaces. Can have platform accounts or exist as external profiles only.

name: judge
description: Judges who evaluate projects and hackathons. Can have platform accounts or exist as external profiles only.
